descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在圣地亚哥做的菜单，折边和露出来的馅分得很清楚。
descriptions.en: My Santiago menu keeps the folded pastry edge distinct from the exposed filling.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 吃过玉米派后做的纸菜单，玉米盖上特地留了一个勺子缺口。
descriptions.en: My paper menu after pastel de choclo leaves a spoon-sized gap in the corn topping.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自己剪的纸签，记下公园里小球碰到邮包的弧线。
descriptions.en: My own cut-paper tab records the ball’s arc towards my bag in the park.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在圣地亚哥自制的圆孔纸卡，挪一挪就能给纸帽子添个影子。
descriptions.en: My homemade circular cutout moves a little shadow across a paper hat.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我把那次找叉子的小事做成纸折页，两个槽只装纸餐具。
descriptions.en: A foldout I made after finding the missing fork, with slots for two paper utensils.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我做的纸转页让小球从两只纸脚之间滚到纸邮包旁。
descriptions.en: My paper wheel sends a little ball between two paper feet towards a paper mailbag.
